articles.title: Crypto Biz: Crypto’s biggest business is starting to look a lot like banking
articles.description: Crypto business is converging with banking as stablecoin reserves, tokenized funds, Treasury income and balance sheet management become key profit drivers.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Fierce backlash to Ethereum’s EIP-8363 staking proposal
articles.description: Ethereum’s proposed EIP-8363 staking overhaul aims to reduce issuance, but critics say it could hurt DeFi, decentralization and institutional adoption.

articles.title: Bitcoiners turn to dice throws as self-custody setups are re-evaluated
articles.description: Dice entropy may become the new gold standard after the Coldcard hack

articles.title: Russia cracks down on 9 crypto exchanges in Moscow City
articles.description: Russia has shut down nine unregistered crypto exchanges in Moscow, with the FSB alleging they helped move scam proceeds abroad through Ukrainian call centers.

articles.title: CEX perpetual futures volume falls to $4T, lowest since late 2023
articles.description: Perpetual futures trading volume on crypto exchanges fell to its lowest level in 31 months, while perpetual trading on decentralized platforms neared a one-year low.

articles.title: Binance Bitcoin volume ratio hits record as futures outweigh spot eight times over
articles.description: Binance saw a record divergence between daily spot and futures trading volumes, with the latter reaching nearly $58 billion.

articles.title: CleanSpark misses Wall Street revenue estimates as shares sink
articles.description: CleanSpark’s shares fell 5.5% on Thursday after the Bitcoin miner reported $138 million in quarterly revenue, narrowly missing Wall Street’s consensus estimate.

articles.title: Stripe-owned Bridge joins EU MiCA register after Luxembourg approval
articles.description: Stripe-owned Bridge has entered the EU MiCA register following Luxembourg approval, joining regulated providers under the bloc’s crypto framework.

articles.title: CLARITY Act delay gives Asian financial hubs an opening: First Digital CEO
articles.description: Industry figures warned that continued legislative limbo could slow institutional adoption, revive regulation by enforcement and push innovation offshore.

articles.title: Coldcard exploit pushes July losses to $247M as second-worst month of 2026
articles.description: The Coldcard exploit, which caused more than $100 million in losses, helped push July crypto thefts to $247 million, making it the second-worst month of 2026.

articles.title: Japan FSA asks crypto exchanges to impose withdrawal delays to fight scams
articles.description: Japanese authorities called for address registration, customer-specific limits and stronger authentication as part of a broader push to curb misuse of exchange accounts.

articles.title: Proposed CLARITY ethics deal could save Trump millions in taxes: Bloomberg
articles.description: The latest bipartisan ethics proposal would reportedly require Trump to divest crypto businesses while allowing him to defer capital gains taxes on those sales.

articles.title: Bitget explores licensed crypto presence in Bhutan
articles.description: Crypto exchange Bitget has signed an agreement with Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority to pursue a regulated local presence.

articles.title: US Senate pushes CLARITY Act vote to September
articles.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune confirmed that the chamber was “punting” the vote until September.

articles.title: MARA swings to Q2 loss as Bitcoin’s slump masks higher output
articles.description: Bitcoin miner MARA posted its highest quarterly Bitcoin production in over a year, but was overshadowed by a 28% decline in the average price of Bitcoin.

articles.title: Crypto market maker Wintermute launches US broker-dealer
articles.description: Wintermute said the registration allows the firm to position itself for the growth of tokenized securities in the US.

articles.title: Following primary loss, crypto PACs invest $1.5M in 3 US state races
articles.description: The Defend American Jobs and Protect Progress PACs reported spending more than $1.5 million on media for four House and Senate races ahead of Aug. 18 primary elections.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows surge after Coldcard hack, but link is unclear: Bloomberg analyst
articles.description: A week-long streak of inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs has coincided with the Coldcard wallet exploit, fueling debate over whether some investors are shifting away from self-custody.

articles.title: US appellate court mandate affirms Sam Bankman-Fried conviction
articles.description: Three circuit judges disputed the former FTX CEO’s claims that the defunct crypto exchange’s investors could have been made whole and wouldn’t have experienced any losses.

articles.title: US Senate will vote on CLARITY crypto bill ‘without any question’ this week: Tim Scott
articles.description: The South Carolina lawmaker who heads the Senate Banking Committee said that the majority leader still had time to put the crypto bill on the agenda despite the narrow voting window.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners’ AI pivot loses Wall Street’s wow factor
articles.description: New analysis finds AI infrastructure contracts are becoming larger and more profitable, but investors now demand stronger execution before rewarding bitcoin mining stocks.

articles.title: Bitcoin price coils under $65K as US PMI data brings new ‘stagflation’ warning
articles.description: Bitcoin price action stayed compressed in an ongoing divergence from stocks and gold while US PMI data sparked fresh talk of “stagflation.”

articles.title: Step App winds down after four years as FITFI token sinks
articles.description: Move-to-earn project Step App will wind down services by Aug. 21 after four years, while its FITFI token trades 99.9% below its all-time high.

articles.title: 10 weirdest things ever tokenized... including farts

articles.title: Blockchain.com wins Cayman custody license after MiCA and FCA approvals
articles.description: Blockchain.com secured a VASP custody license from the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority, expanding its regulated crypto services in the region.

articles.title: Hyperliquid RWA contracts grow to 32% of trading activity in Q2
articles.description: Tokenized real-world assets accounted for more than a third of Hyperliquid’s quarterly trading volume, generating 6.6% of the protocol’s $169 million quarterly revenue.

articles.title: Zeus Wallet taken offline after cyberattack, says no customer funds at risk
articles.description: The self-custodial Bitcoin Lightning Network wallet disabled infrastructure after an incident and founder Evan Kaloudis said no customer funds were lost and no Lightning vulnerability was found.

articles.title: Crypto wrench attacks steal more than $30M so far in 2026: Chainalysis
articles.description: While only 12 of 46 documented attempts resulted in payment, data leaks and attacks on relatives are widening the physical risks facing crypto holders.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury trade ‘breaking’ and fund holdings drop 10%: Analysis
articles.description: Doubts emerge over the Bitcoin corporate treasury model as institutional BTC investment vehicles cut holdings.
